Front: CHCl3, KOH 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Dichlorocarbene addition (carbene-dichloro) — Family: syn (concerted) | Stereo: syn, stereospecific
Why: Intermediate：none; :CCl2 forms by deprotonation of CHCl3 giving ⁻CCl3, then loss of Cl⁻

Front: HIO4, H2O 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Periodate cleavage of 1,2-diols (diol-cleavage) — Family: cleavage (oxidative cleavage) | Stereo: n/a
Why: Intermediate：cyclic periodate ester

Front: RCO3H (e.g. mCPBA) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Epoxidation (epoxidation) — Family: syn (concerted) | Stereo: syn; stereospecific (cis alkene → cis-substituted epoxide)
Why: Intermediate：none (concerted); the epoxide is the PRODUCT

Front: RCO3H (e.g. mCPBA) (Epoxidation) 的 stereo (syn / anti / cannot say)？
Why: Family: syn (concerted)；Intermediate: none (concerted); the epoxide is the PRODUCT

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + RCO3H → ?
Why:
RCO3H gives concerted syn epoxide (product); H3O⁺ opens protonated epoxide from the back (anti → trans-1,2-diol)
SMILESCC12CCCCC1O2

Front: H3O⁺ 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Acid-catalyzed epoxide hydrolysis (epoxide-hydrolysis) — Family: anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack) | Stereo: anti → trans-1,2-diol
Why: Intermediate：protonated epoxide

Front: H3O⁺ 的 regio？
Why: Acid-catalyzed epoxide hydrolysis — Intermediate: protonated epoxide (anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack))

Front: H3O⁺ (Acid-catalyzed epoxide hydrolysis) 的 stereo (syn / anti / cannot say)？
Why: Family: anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack)；Intermediate: protonated epoxide

Front: X2, H2O 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Halohydrin formation (halohydrin) — Family: anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack) | Stereo: anti
Why: Intermediate：halonium ion

Front: X2, H2O 的 regio？
Back: Markovnikov: OH on more substituted C
Why: Halohydrin formation — Intermediate: halonium ion (anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack))

Front: 對比：`halohydrin` (`X2, H2O`) vs `x2-addition` (`X2, CH2Cl2`) 的差異？
Back: water is the solvent, so it outcompetes X⁻; vs x2-addition
Why: Halohydrin formation: intermediate = halonium ion, regio = Markovnikov: OH on more substituted C, stereo = anti

Front: HCl / HBr / HI, ether 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Hydrohalogenation (HX addition) (hx-addition) — Family: cation (carbocation intermediate) | Stereo: not stereospecific
Why: Intermediate：carbocation

Front: HCl / HBr / HI, ether 的 regio？
Why: Hydrohalogenation (HX addition) — Intermediate: carbocation (cation (carbocation intermediate))

Front: HCl / HBr / HI, ether (Hydrohalogenation (HX addition)) 的 stereo (syn / anti / cannot say)？
Why: Family: cation (carbocation intermediate)；Intermediate: carbocation

Front: HCl / HBr / HI, ether (Hydrohalogenation (HX addition)) 是否會發生 Rearrangement？
Back: YES, possible（因為經過 carbocation intermediate）
Why: Intermediate 為 carbocation（只有經由自由 carbocation 才會發生 rearrangement）

Front: 對比：`HX addition` vs `oxymercuration` 的異同？
Back: vs oxymercuration：兩者皆為 Markovnikov，但 `hx-addition` 經由 carbocation 會發生 rearrangement；`oxymercuration` 經由 mercurinium ion，NO rearrangement。
Why: Hydrohalogenation (HX addition): intermediate = carbocation, regio = Markovnikov (H on less substituted C), stereo = not stereospecific

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + HBr → ?
Why:
Markovnikov addition via tertiary carbocation intermediate
SMILESCC1(Br)CCCCC1

Front: 預測產物：3,3-dimethyl-1-butene + HBr → ?
Why:
Markovnikov protonation gives 2° carbocation → 1,2-methyl shift to 3° carbocation → Br⁻ attack
SMILESCC(C)C(C)(C)Br

Front: 1. BH3, THF; 2. H2O2, OH⁻ 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Why: Intermediate：none (concerted, 4-center TS)

Front: 1. BH3, THF; 2. H2O2, OH⁻ 的 regio？
Why: Hydroboration–oxidation — Intermediate: none (concerted, 4-center TS) (syn (concerted))

Front: 1. BH3, THF; 2. H2O2, OH⁻ (Hydroboration–oxidation) 的 stereo (syn / anti / cannot say)？
Why: Family: syn (concerted)；Intermediate: none (concerted, 4-center TS)

Front: 1. BH3, THF; 2. H2O2, OH⁻ (Hydroboration–oxidation) 是否會發生 Rearrangement？
Why: Intermediate 為 none (concerted, 4-center TS)（只有經由自由 carbocation 才會發生 rearrangement）

Front: 對比：`hydroboration` vs `oxymercuration` 的水合結果差異？
Back: vs oxymercuration：hydroboration 為 anti-Markovnikov 且 syn addition（concerted, 4-center TS）；oxymercuration 為 Markovnikov（經由 mercurinium ion，且 NaBH4 step scrambles stereo）。
Why: Hydroboration–oxidation: intermediate = none (concerted, 4-center TS), regio = anti-Markovnikov (OH on less substituted C), stereo = syn

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + BH3; H2O2/OH⁻ → ?
Why:
anti-Markovnikov (OH on less substituted C) + syn addition (H and OH cis, so OH and CH3 are trans)
SMILESC[C@@H]1CCCC[C@H]1O

Front: H2, Pd/C or PtO2 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Catalytic hydrogenation (hydrogenation) — Family: syn (concerted) | Stereo: syn
Why: Intermediate：none (concerted on catalyst surface)

Front: KMnO4, H3O⁺ 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: KMnO4 oxidative cleavage (kmno4-cleavage) — Family: cleavage (oxidative cleavage) | Stereo: n/a
Why: Intermediate：n/a

Front: 對比：`kmno4-cleavage` (`KMnO4, H3O⁺`) vs `ozonolysis` (`O3; Zn/H3O⁺`) 的氧化程度？
Back: overoxidizes: C–H becomes COOH, =CH2 becomes CO2; vs ozonolysis（`ozonolysis` 停在 aldehyde/ketone）。
Why: KMnO4 oxidative cleavage: intermediate = n/a, regio = n/a, stereo = n/a

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + KMnO4/H3O⁺ → ?
Why:
Oxidative cleavage overoxidizes vinylic C–H to COOH while trisubstituted C= becomes ketone
SMILESCC(=O)CCCCC(=O)O

Front: 1. OsO4; 2. NaHSO3, H2O (or cat. OsO4 + NMO) 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Dihydroxylation (OsO4) (oso4-hydroxylation) — Family: syn (concerted) | Stereo: syn → cis-1,2-diol
Why: Intermediate：cyclic osmate ester

Front: 1. OsO4; 2. NaHSO3, H2O (or cat. OsO4 + NMO) (Dihydroxylation (OsO4)) 的 stereo (syn / anti / cannot say)？
Why: Family: syn (concerted)；Intermediate: cyclic osmate ester

Front: 對比：`OsO4 hydroxylation` vs `epoxide-hydrolysis` (`RCO3H` then `H3O⁺`) 的 diol 立體化學？
Back: vs epoxide-hydrolysis：`OsO4` 經由 cyclic osmate ester 進行 syn hydroxylation 得到 cis-1,2-diol；`epoxide-hydrolysis` (`RCO3H` then `H3O⁺`) 經由 protonated epoxide 背面開環 (anti) 得到 trans-1,2-diol。
Why: Dihydroxylation (OsO4): intermediate = cyclic osmate ester, regio = n/a, stereo = syn → cis-1,2-diol

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + OsO4 → ?
Why:
Concerted syn hydroxylation via cyclic osmate ester gives cis-1,2-diol
SMILESC[C@]1(O)CCCC[C@H]1O

Front: 1. Hg(OAc)2, H2O/THF; 2. NaBH4 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Oxymercuration–demercuration (oxymercuration) — Family: three-membered-ring intermediate, then Nu opens the ring | Stereo: cannot be called syn/anti (NaBH4 step scrambles it)
Why: Intermediate：mercurinium ion

Front: 1. Hg(OAc)2, H2O/THF; 2. NaBH4 的 regio？
Why: Oxymercuration–demercuration — Intermediate: mercurinium ion (three-membered-ring intermediate, then Nu opens the ring)

Front: 1. Hg(OAc)2, H2O/THF; 2. NaBH4 (Oxymercuration–demercuration) 的 stereo (syn / anti / cannot say)？
Back: cannot be called syn/anti (NaBH4 step scrambles it)
Why: Family: three-membered-ring intermediate, then Nu opens the ring；Intermediate: mercurinium ion

Front: 1. Hg(OAc)2, H2O/THF; 2. NaBH4 (Oxymercuration–demercuration) 是否會發生 Rearrangement？
Why: Intermediate 為 mercurinium ion（只有經由自由 carbocation 才會發生 rearrangement）

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + Hg(OAc)2/H2O; NaBH4 → ?
Why:
Markovnikov hydration via mercurinium ion; NO rearrangement
SMILESCC1(O)CCCCC1

Front: 預測產物：3,3-dimethyl-1-butene + Hg(OAc)2/H2O; NaBH4 → ?
Why:
Markovnikov hydration via mercurinium ion prevents methyl shift (NO rearrangement)
SMILESCC(O)C(C)(C)C

Front: 1. O3; 2. Zn/H3O⁺ 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Ozonolysis (ozonolysis) — Family: cleavage (oxidative cleavage) | Stereo: n/a
Why: Intermediate：ozonide

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + O3; Zn → ?
Why:
Reductive ozonolysis cleaves C=C and stops at ketone + aldehyde (no overoxidation)
SMILESCC(=O)CCCCC=O

Front: CH2I2, Zn(Cu), ether 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Simmons–Smith reaction (simmons-smith) — Family: syn (concerted) | Stereo: syn, stereospecific
Why: Intermediate：carbenoid

Front: 對比：`simmons-smith` vs `carbene-dichloro` 的試劑、中間體與產物差異？
Back: vs carbene-dichloro：`simmons-smith` 以 `CH2I2, Zn(Cu), ether` 經由 carbenoid 形成無鹵素取代的 cyclopropane；`carbene-dichloro` 以 `CHCl3, KOH` 產生 `:CCl2` 形成 dichlorocyclopropane，兩者皆為 syn, stereospecific。
Why: Simmons–Smith reaction: intermediate = carbenoid, regio = n/a, stereo = syn, stereospecific

Front: Cl2 or Br2, CH2Cl2 是什麼反應？family 與 stereo？
Back: Halogenation (X2 addition) (x2-addition) — Family: anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack) | Stereo: anti
Why: Intermediate：halonium ion

Front: Cl2 or Br2, CH2Cl2 (Halogenation (X2 addition)) 的 stereo (syn / anti / cannot say)？
Why: Family: anti (three-membered ring opened by back-side attack)；Intermediate: halonium ion

Front: 預測產物：1-methylcyclohexene + Br2 → ?
Why:
anti addition via bromonium ion opened by back-side Br⁻ attack
SMILESC[C@]1(Br)CCCC[C@@H]1Br
